sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Fifth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(FIFTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXV of 2002
An Ordinance to
further amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th August, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(25)/2002,
dated 17-8-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local
Government (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 158 of Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(FIFTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXV of 2002
An Ordinance to
further amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th August, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(25)/2002,
dated 17-8-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 158 of
Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.---In the Sindh Local Government
Ordinance, 2001, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, for section
158, the following shall be substituted:--
"158. Bar Against Nazis
for dual membership, etc.---A Zila Nazim, Naib Zila Nazim, Taluka Nazim,
Naib Taluka Nazim, Town Nazim, Naib Town Nazim, Union Nazim and Naib Union
Nazim may contest election for any other political office after resigning from
the existing office of Nazim, or, as the case may be, Naib Nazim;
Provided that a member of Zila
Council, Taluka Council, Town Council or Union Council may contest election for
any other political office without resigning from the membership of such
Council;
Provided further that such member
shall not hold more than one office at one time."
